## About
Alfa Performance Connection is an Orange, California shop for Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati sales, service, repair and accessories. We also offer Alfa Performance Online Parts.
The shop is run by Stuart, who took over the business from his father. Customers tell us they come back year after year with their Alfas, and one called us the place to go in the OC if you want your Alfa Romeo maintained properly.
We're rated 4.6 from 27 Google reviews. Thank you to everyone who has trusted us with their car.

## Services
- Service: Maintenance for Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati.
- Repair: Repair work for Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati.
- Sales: Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati sales.
- Accessories: Accessories for Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati.
- Alfa Performance Online Parts: Parts available through our online parts page.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: Alfa Romeo, Ferrari and Maserati. One reviewer also mentions Stuart working on Lamborghinis.

Q: Do you work on older Alfas?
A: Yes. One reviewer says the owner has worked on Alfas old and new, right up until the new Giulia.

Q: When are you open?
A: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Friday through Monday.
